    - "*.lan"
    - "+.local"
  default-nameserver:
    - 1.1.1.1
    - 8.8.8.8
  proxy-server-nameserver:
    - 1.1.1.1
    - 8.8.8.8
  nameserver:
    - https://1.1.1.1/dns-query
    - https://dns.google/dns-query

proxies:
  - name: de-vless-xray
    type: vless
    server: de.example.com
    port: 443
    uuid: 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
    network: tcp
    tls: true
    udp: true
    servername: www.example.com
    flow: xtls-rprx-vision
    client-fingerprint: chrome
    reality-opts:
      public-key: PUB
      short-id: ab
  - name: nl-ws-xray
    type: vless
    server: nl.example.com
    port: 443
    uuid: 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
    network: ws
    tls: true
    udp: true
    servername: nl.example.com
    alpn: [h2, http/1.1]
    client-fingerprint: firefox
    ws-opts:
      path: /w
      headers:
        Host: cdn.example.com
  - name: fi-xhttp-xray
    type: vless
    server: fi.example.com
    port: 443
    uuid: 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
    network: xhttp
    tls: true
    udp: true
    servername: www.example.org
    client-fingerprint: chrome
    reality-opts:
      public-key: PUB2
      short-id: cd
    xhttp-opts:
      path: /x
      mode: stream-one
  - name: se-vmess-xray
    type: vmess
    server: se.example.com
    port: 443
    uuid: 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
    alterId: 0
    cipher: auto
    network: ws
    tls: false
    udp: true
    ws-opts:
      path: /v
  - name: pl-trojan-xray
    type: trojan
    server: pl.example.com
    port: 443
    password: 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
    network: grpc
    tls: true
    udp: true
    servername: pl.example.com
    skip-cert-verify: true
    client-fingerprint: chrome
    grpc-opts:
      grpc-service-name: svc
  - name: "stand-cascade → SE"
    type: vless
    server: cz.example.com
    port: 443
    uuid: 11111111-1111-0001-8111-111111111111
    network: tcp
    tls: true
    udp: true
    servername: www.example.net
    flow: xtls-rprx-vision
    client-fingerprint: chrome
    reality-opts:
      public-key: PUB3
      short-id: ef
  - name: "stand-cascade → DE"
    type: vless
    server: cz.example.com
    port: 443
    uuid: 11111111-1111-0002-8111-111111111111
    network: tcp
    tls: true
    udp: true
    servername: www.example.net
    flow: xtls-rprx-vision
    client-fingerprint: chrome
    reality-opts:
      public-key: PUB3
      short-id: ef
  - name: hy-hysteria
    type: hysteria2
    server: hy.example.com
    port: 443
    password: "p w"
    obfs: salamander
    obfs-password: ob
    ports: 20000-30000
    fingerprint: aabb
  - name: ss-shadowsocks
    type: ss
    server: ss.example.com
    port: 443
    cipher: chacha20-ietf-poly1305
    password: p
    udp: true
  - name: tuic-tuic
    type: tuic
    server: tu.example.com
    port: 443
    uuid: 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
    password: p
    congestion-controller: bbr
    alpn: [h3]
    sni: www.example.com
    udp-relay-mode: native
    skip-cert-verify: true
  - name: anytls-anytls
    type: anytls
    server: an.example.com
    port: 443
    password: p
    sni: www.example.com
    skip-cert-verify: true
  - name: stls-shadowtls
    type: ss
    server: st.example.com
    port: 443
    cipher: 2022-blake3-aes-128-gcm
    password: p
    plugin: shadow-tls
    plugin-opts:
      host: www.example.com
      password: p
      version: 3
    udp: true
  - name: mieru-mieru
    type: mieru
    server: mi.example.com
    port: 443
    transport: TCP
    username: u
    password: p
  - name: tg-socks-socks
    type: socks5
    server: tg.example.com
    port: 443
    username: bob
    password: pw
    udp: false
  - name: tg-http-http
    type: http
    server: tg.example.com
    port: 443
    username: bob
    password: pw

proxy-groups:
  - name: Auto
    type: url-test
    url: http://www.gstatic.com/generate_204
    interval: 300
    proxies:
      - de-vless-xray
      - nl-ws-xray
      - fi-xhttp-xray
      - se-vmess-xray
      - pl-trojan-xray
      - "stand-cascade → SE"
      - "stand-cascade → DE"
      - hy-hysteria
      - ss-shadowsocks
      - tuic-tuic
      - anytls-anytls
      - stls-shadowtls
      - mieru-mieru
      - tg-socks-socks
      - tg-http-http
